name: rosetta-accumulator-factory-01-generic-over-any-number
code:
use IO.Std.write_line
use System.Numerics.INumber
use System.Numerics.IAdditionOperators.`+

accumulator[T: INumber[T]](initial: T) -> T -> T is
    let sum mut = initial

    return value => (
        sum = sum + value
        sum
    )
si

let x = accumulator(1)

x(5)

accumulator(3)

write_line(x(2))

let y = accumulator(1.0D)

y(5.0D)

accumulator(3.0D)

write_line(y(2.3D))

let z = accumulator(System.Int128.one)

z(System.Int128.parse("123456789012345678901234567890"))

write_line(z(System.Int128.one))
